pages.text: I can force a Zombie Villager through its ordinary cure immediately.

$(bold)Mana:$() 2 buckets$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Aim at a Zombie Villager within twelve blocks. The spell invokes vanilla conversion with an almost immediate completion time, preserving the normal villager data, cure attribution, and resulting behavior rather than spawning a generic replacement.
